name: Halfway seesaw
summary: Where two friends should meet, drawn as a little town map with each of them at their end and walking rings around them; every spot sits where it is, a green dot marks the fairest walk, and under the map a seesaw weighs their two walks for the spot in play and tips toward whoever walks further. Tap a spot to suggest it; pick the same one and it's set.
useWhen: you're at larkin, i'm at second chapter. where do we meet
meet halfway? i'm downtown you're on campus
somewhere in between us for lunch
where's fair for both of us to walk to
pick a spot in the middle, i'm not walking 20 min lol
dontUseWhen: a whole group meeting up (use meeting-time or poll-map)
picking a time rather than a place (use coffee-seat)

title.description: Card title, e.g. 'Meet in the middle'

quote.description: What started it, in their words

spots.description: 2 to 5 places to meet, placed between them

minA.description: Walking minutes for the first person

minB.description: Walking minutes for the second person

picked.description: Spot names already suggested, same order as people ('' for none)
